description: Per-(search_query x matched_keyword x keyword_match_type) ad performance inside specific advertiser campaign(s) over one period: raw ad spend, impressions, clicks, and top-of-search impressions. Scoped to given advertiser os_client_id(s) and marketing campaign_id(s); optionally filter by search_query. CTR / CPC / CPM and top-of-search impression share are derived downstream from these raw aggregates.

search_query.description: The search term the user typed (lowercased). Optional filter to scope to specific queries.

matched_keyword.description: The targeted keyword that matched the search query.

keyword_match_type.description: Match type by which the keyword matched the search query (EXACT / PHRASE / BROAD / ...).

os_client_id.description: Advertiser client_id. Mandatory filter: one or more advertiser client_ids to scope the report to.

campaign_id.description: Marketing campaign_id (lowercased). Mandatory filter: one or more marketing campaign_ids to scope the report to.

spend.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN r.cost ELSE 0 END), 0)
spend.description: Ad spend for this search_query x keyword x match_type over the period (raw cost from the report; the legacy source does not currency-convert this metric).

impressions.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN r.impressions ELSE 0 END), 0)
impressions.description: Ad impressions served for this search_query x keyword x match_type.

clicks.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN r.clicks ELSE 0 END), 0)
clicks.description: Ad clicks (visits) for this search_query x keyword x match_type.

top_of_search_impressions.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN (CASE WHEN a.is_impression_ad_position_enabled = TRUE THEN r.top_position_search_impressions ELSE r.top_search_keyword_impressions END) ELSE 0 END), 0)
top_of_search_impressions.description: Impressions served in the top-of-search position. Uses top_position_search_impressions when the agency has is_impression_ad_position_enabled, else top_search_keyword_impressions. Top-of-search share (= top_of_search_impressions / impressions) is derived downstream.

query.REPORTING: SELECT __ATTRIBUTES__, __METRICS__ FROM `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.os_ads_search_query_performance_report` AS r INNER JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.campaign_tagging_data` AS ctd ON ctd.client_id = r.client_id AND ctd.account_id = r.account_id AND ctd.campaign_id = r.campaign_id INNER JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.marketing_campaign_dimensions` AS mcd ON ctd.client_id = mcd.client_id AND ctd.marketing_campaign_id = mcd.marketing_campaign_id INNER JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.agencies` AS a ON a.marketplace_client_id = r.marketplace_client_id WHERE a.agency_id = '__AGENCY_ID__' AND r.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' AND (mcd.campaign_origin != 'PACKAGE_BASED' OR mcd.campaign_origin IS NULL) AND __FILTER__ GROUP BY __ATTRIBUTES_GROUP_BY__ ORDER BY __ATTRIBUTES_ORDER_BY__ LIMIT __LIMIT__ OFFSET __OFFSET__;
